input.subject: What is this $79 line on my invoice?
input.body: My invoice this month has a $79 line I don't recognize next to the usual Pro plan charge. What is it?

intent: Explains what the unfamiliar charge most likely is and how to confirm it against the account, in plain warm language, and ends with a concrete next step. Does not treat this as a refund request.

input.subject: Payment failed twice
input.body: We got two emails saying our card was declined and now the dashboard shows a billing warning. The card works everywhere else.

intent: Walks the customer through fixing the failed payment with specific, ordered steps and says what happens to the account meanwhile. Stays practical rather than deflecting to a lead.

input.subject: Refund for last week's Pro charge
input.body: I was charged for Pro on the 3rd, six days ago, and I want to cancel and get that refunded.

intent: Engages with a clearly in-policy refund request and moves it forward — confirms it looks eligible under the 30-day window and states the verification step before any amount is committed. Must NOT refuse, stall, or hand the whole thing to a lead: over-cautious non-answers fail this case just as hard as promising a figure.
